{{Quote|Well, that sure complicates things, Commander.''"<br />"''No worse than that time on Tibrin.''"<br />"''We had Jedi with us on Tibrin. They ''helped''.|Captain Rex and Commander Cody|<ref name="rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Tibrin''' (pronounced /ˈtɪbrɪn/ or /tɪˈbrɪn/) was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]].

==History==
[[File:Tibrin_revolution.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The Ishi Tib welcome Dooku as a hero.]]
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was completely [[Waterworld/Legends|covered]] by small [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], with many [[Coral/Legends|coral]] reefs and sandbars protruding to the surface. The ocean currents distributed warm water around the planet creating a temperate zone which covered the entire planet. [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] cities were built on the reefs and even built out of their material. Edible seaweed was grown and fish were bred for food in Tibrin's underwater corrals.

Because of the Ishi Tib's reliance on the planet's natural resources, environmental efforts were a primary consideration on the planet. Technology was carefully tested before it was implemented into their society. In an effort to further this environmentalism, Ishi Tib used beasts to perform many tasks on the planet that would normally be performed by machines.

During the [[Galactic War]], a strange [[Algae/Legends|algae]] grew in the southern reefs of Tibrin and caused [[Fish/Legends|fishes]] that ate it to explode.<ref name="Mission" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] planet was ruled by the murderous dictator [[Suribran Tu]], who initially sided with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] [[Tibrin revolution|conquered]] the world in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Tu offered to work with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], but was instead [[Death/Legends|executed]] by Dooku to gain the sympathy and support of the Ishi Tib. Dooku's strategy worked splendidly, and the populace hailed him as a liberator.<ref name="CD" />

[[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] then was made temporary Confederate [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Tibrin.<ref name="CD" /> It was the site of the [[Battle of Tibrin]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Tibrin in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
